name: dogfood-observability-slo-app
description: Dogfood app v1.35-2 — an SLO / SLI / error budget + burn rate + multi-window multi-burn-rate alerting harness driven behind a provider-neutral surface backed by @kiwa/observability v2.1 semantics (SLO axis) + real-driver env-gate. Two adapter implementations satisfy the same 14-op contract: makeMockAdapter walks the observability v2.1 SLO state machine deterministically without any backend; makeRealAdapter emits PromQL query + Alertmanager route requests through the KIWA_MODE=real testcontainers-driven Grafana OSS + Prometheus stack when KIWA_PROMETHEUS_URL / KIWA_GRAFANA_URL are wired, and otherwise reports KIWA_SLO_ENV_MISSING so callers can budget the fallback. The fidelity harness diffs both traces side-by-side across 3 SLO target objectives (99.9 / 99.95 / 99.99) × 4 canonical burn-rate windows (fast 1h/5m + slow 6h/30m Google SRE MWMBR pattern) so behavioural drift between mock semantics and real Prometheus + Alertmanager stays observable and feeds the @kiwa/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/observability -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
